selection.criterion: 5-fold stratified CV log loss on the train split

drift_simulation.note: SIMULATED shifts of the held-out customers. The dataset is a static snapshot; no real drift was observed.

scenarios.scenario: No shift (held-out customers as they are)
Fibre migration: half of DSL customers moved to fibre (+$20/mo)
Contract mix: 40% of term contracts lapse to month-to-month

checks.check: Profit beats contacting everyone and is positive
Every segment with n >= 150 calibrated within 10%
Log loss non-inferior to champion (upper 95% bound of difference <= +0.01)
Profit non-inferior to champion (lower 95% bound of difference >= -2,986)
